limitations: The result concerns stationary two-state alternating renewal processes with independent positive sojourns and finite means. Full paths, holding times, higher-order distributions, or age-conditioned transitions can distinguish the aliased models. Equivalent older inverse observations under different terminology remain a residual originality risk.
provenance: An inverse second-order analysis of stationary alternating renewal processes, with an explicit phase-type non-Markov construction exactly matching every two-state Markov pair law.
record_title: Markov two-time laws do not identify memorylessness in stationary alternating renewal processes
